$comment: Presentation for monsters extracted from the disc (vallode/mhfu-blacksmith#35): the site name,
the data/monsters file and, per committed hitzone part and drop group, the disc slot it shows.
hitzones: part -> [table, row] in the emChunk HitzoneTbl list. drops: rank label -> group label
-> "kind/rank", kind body|tail|shiny|capture|break:<type>, rank one of the disc slots.
Generated by matching the committed data against the EU disc, then reviewed: parts matched by
value one-to-one per monster (11 rows by closest values, listed in the PR); drop groups by the
label rules in README "Monster overlays", break parts by exact-list votes. Groups and parts left
out have no unambiguous disc slot and stay as committed. Fatalis's two horn breaks (1 and 2) have
identical lists, so votes can't tell them apart; as for Crimson and White Fatalis, the break table
(monsters/breaks.ts) breaks 2 on part 5's 1st flinch and 1 on its 2nd, so 1st horn is 2.
